Method of Attack: Infostealer malware that infects victim computers to exfiltrate saved browser credentials, session cookies, credit card information, cryptocurrency wallet data, and other sensitive host information
Distributed via Malware as a Service (MaaS) monthly subscription packages with command and control (C2) infrastructure and backend for managing stealer logs
Distribution vectors include cracked software, phishing emails, malvertising, and advertising free video-game currency
Stealer logs exfiltrated to backend infrastructure and distributed primarily via Telegram channels
Used by initial access brokers (IABs) to gain initial access to company networks, which is then auctioned on dark web forums for ransomware affiliates
Impacted Systems: Victim computers infected with infostealer malware
Corporate applications including single-sign on (SSO) portals, cloud environments, and other high-value applications
Attack Vector: Infection via infostealer payloads added to cracked software
